import numpy as np,json
from PIL import Image
from rcb_client import Robot
r=Robot(); s=r.spec(); limits=np.array(s['qpos']['range']); names=s['qpos']['layout']; jnames=s['proprio']['joints']
base=np.zeros(61); base[[2,7]]=-.4; base[[3,8]]=.8; base[[4,9]]=-.4
log=[]
def action(q): return np.clip(2*(np.array(q)-limits[:,0])/(limits[:,1]-limits[:,0])-1,-1,1)
def save(o):
 for k,v in o.get('images',{}).items(): Image.fromarray(v).save('/app/output/'+k+'.png')
 print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in o.items() if k not in ('images','depth')}),flush=True)
def step(q=None,n=1,images=True):
 q=base.copy() if q is None else q
 a=action(q); log.extend([a.tolist()]*n)
 o=r.step('qpos',np.tile(a,(n,1)),images=images); save(o); np.save('/app/output/last_actions.npy',np.array(log));return o
def reset():
 global log
 log=[]; o=r.reset();save(o);return o
print('READY',flush=True)

def joint_for_link(link):

 if link=='left_hand':return 'left_wrist_yaw'
 if link=='right_hand':return 'right_wrist_yaw'
 if link.endswith('_link'):return link[:-5]
 prefix,part=link.split('_',1)
 if part=='wrist':return prefix+'_WRJ2'
 if part=='palm':return prefix+'_WRJ1'
 fingers={'ff':'FF','mf':'MF','rf':'RF','lf':'LF','th':'TH'}
 if part=='lfmetacarpal':return prefix+'_LFJ5'
 if part.startswith('th'):
  suffix={'thbase':'THJ5','thproximal':'THJ4','thhub':'THJ3','thmiddle':'THJ2','thdistal':'THJ1'}[part]
 else:
  suffix=fingers[part[:2]]+{'knuckle':'J4','proximal':'J3','middle':'J2','distal':'J1'}[part[2:]]
